_readme: Indexable pages agreed to stay unreachable from / even when a PR adds or visibly changes them. Read by scripts/lib/link-graph.js for npm run check:link-reachability (the gate) and npm run audit:link-reachability (the dashboard). The gate is delta-scoped, so a page that is ALREADY an island and that a PR does not touch never needs an entry here: it is reported as pre-existing, not counted. An entry is only for the narrower case where a page must be edited or shipped while it stays deliberately unlinked, for example a page under active measurement. An entry here is a DISCUSSED DECISION with the user, exactly like data/library_hub_exclusions.json. Never add one to make a PR pass: the default fix is one link from a page / reaches. Excused pages are still reported every run. Entry shape: { route, reason, decided, decidedBy, nextRecheck } - `route` is the public path with a trailing slash (e.g. '/uk/'), `reason` says why it stays unlinked in prose a future session can evaluate, `decided` and `nextRecheck` are ISO dates, `decidedBy` names the discussion. The list ships empty on purpose (2026-11-01): no page has an agreed exception yet.
